description:
The crypto assets trending right now by 24h search volume. Use it when the user asks what is popular, what the market is paying attention to, or wants a discovery view rather than a specific asset lookup.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_trending
